depot.physicalOnlyDesc: To guarantee the maximum security of your funds, {{bank}} has chosen to only accept deposits made in person at a branch.
depot.reason1Desc: In-person deposits eliminate any risk of online fraud or fund interception.
depot.reason2Desc: Every deposit is recorded, time-stamped and validated by a branch advisor.
depot.reason3Desc: Your OJADA BANK advisor verifies your identity at every transaction to protect you.
depot.reason4Desc: This procedure complies with ACPR requirements and anti-money-laundering standards.
depot.immediateCreditDesc: Your balance is credited instantly once validated by the branch advisor.

depot.step2Desc: Bring a valid ID and your account number: {{account}}
depot.step3Desc: Give your deposit (cash or cheque) to your advisor.
depot.step4Desc: The amount appears instantly on your balance after validation.

verification.title: Blocked funds
verification.subtitle: Your funds are temporarily unavailable
verification.feeDesc: To unlock your funds, you must start an account verification process. This fee covers the full audit of your file by our compliance team.
verification.contractIntro: Between OJADA BANK (hereinafter "the Bank") and {{name}}, holder of account no. {{account}} (hereinafter "the Client").
verification.article1Body: This contract sets out the terms of the account verification process enabling the unlocking of the Client's funds.
verification.article2Body: The Client agrees to pay the sum of {{fee}} as verification fees. This amount may be paid in full or in successive instalments, at the Client's convenience.
verification.article3Body: The Client acknowledges and agrees to pay the full verification fee, whether in one payment or in staggered instalments, before any unlocking of funds. No refund will be issued in the event of withdrawal.
verification.article4Title: Article 4 — Maintaining the account during the audit
verification.article4Body: To keep the account valid during the audit, the Client agrees to make a minimum monthly deposit of {{alimFee}} to keep the account active. Any failure to make the monthly deposit may jeopardize the unlocking process.
verification.article5Body: Once the fees have been paid in full and the file has been fully verified, OJADA BANK will unlock the funds within a reasonable period, following manual confirmation by an administrator.
verification.article6Body: This contract is governed by French law and applicable banking regulations.
verification.monthlyDepositWarningBody: By signing this contract, you agree to make a minimum monthly deposit of {{alimFee}} to keep your account active during the audit. Without this deposit, the unlocking process may be jeopardized.
verification.signatureLabel: Electronic signature — Enter your full name exactly:
verification.signatureRequiredError: Please enter your full name as a signature.
verification.signatureMismatchError: The signature must exactly match your full name: {{name}}
verification.monthlyReminderPaymentStep: so as not to jeopardize the audit, don't forget to deposit at least {{alimFee}} into your account each month.
verification.waitingBody: Our team is verifying your transaction. You will be notified once it is validated.
verification.invalidAmountError: Invalid amount or higher than the remaining balance ({{amount}}).
verification.paymentCompleteBody: You have paid the full verification fee ({{fee}}). Our team is carrying out the final review of your file. Your account will be unlocked very soon.
verification.monthlyReminderDoneStep: while waiting for final unlocking, keep depositing at least {{alimFee}} into your account each month so as not to jeopardize the audit.

landing.heroP: OJADA BANK offers you reliable, fast and accessible banking services. Manage your accounts and carry out your transactions from Villejuif.
landing.servicesSub: Banking solutions designed for individuals and businesses in the Paris region.
landing.service1Desc: A flexible account for your everyday transactions. Deposits, withdrawals and transfers.
landing.service2Desc: Grow your money with a competitive interest rate. Your savings, protected.
landing.service3Desc: Solutions dedicated to SMEs. Multi-user management and advanced tracking tools.
landing.service4Desc: Transfer money instantly to any OJADA account.
landing.service5Desc: Access the full history of your transactions and statements online.
landing.service6Desc: Funds protected by strict banking protocols and continuous monitoring.
landing.step1Desc: Fill out your application online with your personal details.
landing.step2Desc: Our team verifies your documents and validates your identity within 24h.
landing.step3Desc: Your account is activated and you receive your access details by SMS.
landing.step4Desc: Make deposits, withdrawals and transfers from your account.
landing.testimonial1Text: "OJADA BANK has simplified my financial management. Transfers are instant and customer service is always available."
landing.testimonial2Text: "Finally a local bank that understands the needs of small businesses. My business account gives me total visibility."
landing.testimonial3Text: "The OJADA savings account has let me set money aside for my project. Clear interface and an attractive rate."
landing.ctaP: Open your account today and enjoy all our banking services with no opening fees.
landing.footerTagline: Your trusted banking partner in Villejuif and the Val-de-Marne.
landing.footerCopyright: © 2026 OJADA BANK. All rights reserved. Villejuif, France.
landing.footerAgreement: Licensed institution · ACPR · Banque de France
